title: Shared current curriculum route map
purpose: Freeze the canonical shared-curriculum route table and every legacy alias before any route code moves. Spec authority: _docs/specs/02-url-link-seo-compatibility.md and open-decisions.md #5.

legacy_aliases.methods: GET,HEAD for HTML; API routes are compatibility endpoints, never redirected cross-host

invariants.no_wildcard_redirects: Every alias is an explicit pattern. A catch-all (*, .* or equivalent) redirect entry is forbidden and the contract test fails on one.
invariants.archive_urls_require_full_commit_sha: A GitHub archive URL is derived only from a validated HTTPS repository URL, a full lowercase 40-character commit SHA, and a cohort-relative notice path: blob/<sha>/<path> for a Markdown notice, tree/<sha>/<path> for a directory. A branch name (main, master) or a self-referential future SHA is forbidden as archive identity.
invariants.canonical_shared_urls_forbid_cohort_quer: Canonical shared module/lesson URLs never contain a cohort segment or a ?cohort= query. Context is a private response variant with private, no-store, never a canonical or sitemap location.
invariants.mutations_never_redirected: Enrollment toggle, submissions, eval mutations, and the read-state toggle keep direct compatibility adapters with the same path-cohort authorization; no POST is replaced by a redirect or a 405 as a side effect of moving HTML routes.
invariants.unknown_identifiers_are_404: Malformed or unknown cohort identifiers and unmapped legacy slugs are real 404s with no nearest-match fallback.
invariants.kwarg_compatibility_window: CLOSED 2026-09-07 (W6): the cohort_year kwarg adapter and cohort_url_kwargs() are removed. Every route converter and view parameter is cohort_identifier, and every generated URL (templates, services, deadlines, calendar, wrapped) reverses the canonical cohorts/<identifier> namespace. Legacy two-segment route names (course, homework, leaderboard, ...) remain registered for inbound old paths only; no generator uses them.
